name: decomposition-microfrontends
description: Angular micro-frontends target state — shell + remote apps using Webpack Module Federation

scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:shell" "npm run start:identity" "npm run start:customer" "npm run start:order" "npm run start:product"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:identity && npm run build:customer && npm run build:order && npm run build:product && npm run build:shell
scripts.install:all: npm ci && (cd apps/shell && npm ci) && (cd apps/identity-mfe && npm ci) && (cd apps/customer-mfe && npm ci) && (cd apps/order-mfe && npm ci) && (cd apps/product-mfe && npm ci)
